edit.name: Output
edit.title: Edit Output
edit.summary: Turns an expression into text and then prints it to the console.

edit.name: Input
edit.title: Edit Input
edit.summary: Prompts the user to write a message that will be stored in memory.

edit.name: Assignment
edit.title: Edit Assignment
edit.summary: Allows the program to directly store a value in memory.

section.heading: Expression
section.note: This allows you to store the same value in multiple places.

section.heading: Options
section.note: Direct: Doesn't change the value. Compound: Applies an operator to a value. Example: a += 5 is same as a = a + 5. Unary: Adds or subtracts 1 to a value. Example: a++ is same as a = a + 1.

edit.name: VariableDeclaration
edit.title: Edit Declaration
edit.summary: Creates a variable and associates it with a data type that can never change.

edit.name: Call
edit.title: Edit Call
edit.summary: Runs any function (labeled section of code). Functions must be followed by parethesis and their arguments must be seperated by commas.

edit.name: Conditional
edit.title: Edit Condition
edit.summary: Evaluates an expression and runs only one branch. Then if true, else if false.

edit.name: While
edit.title: Edit While
edit.summary: The code block will repeat until the condition is false. If it is false from the beginning no instructions from the block will be run.

edit.name: Do
edit.title: Edit Do While
edit.summary: The code block inside do while will run at least once, then it will stop if the condition is false.

edit.name: For
edit.title: Edit For Loop
edit.summary: The code block inside for will repeat until the counter will reach the end of the range. Range start, end, step size and direction along with the counter are all configurable.

edit.name: Breakpoint
edit.title: Edit Breakpoint
edit.summary: Breakpoint temporarily pauses code execution in order to make debugging easier for the developer.

exclusive.item: Break if expression evaluates to true

edit.name: Comment
edit.title: Edit Comment
edit.summary: Comments are used to explain what a section of code does. They're only used for readability and they have no effect.

edit.name: FunctionSignature
edit.title: Edit Function
edit.summary: Functions group related code into a single block. You can pass data into them using parameters and they can return a value that you may use after calling it.
